lines.text: Never fall asleep in a waiting room.
The sign said: take a number. Mine was 47.
lines.say: The sign said: take a number. Mine was forty-seven.

lines.text: The screen said: now serving 12. It never moved.
lines.say: The screen said: now serving twelve. It never moved.

lines.text: Nobody else had a number. Nobody else moved.
I closed my eyes. Just for a second.
When I woke up, the clock said 3 AM.
lines.say: When I woke up, the clock said three A.M.

lines.text: Every chair was full. And they were all staring at me.
A nurse opened the door. She smiled. Your turn.
Behind me, a man took number 48.
lines.say: Behind me, a man took number forty-eight.

lines.text: So never fall asleep in a waiting room.
